en.title: From "full frame" to "full score": Snapdragon uses "AI + gaming" to promote the next golden decade of mobile gaming
en.summary: Introduction: When "full frame" becomes the starting point, what is the next stop for mobile games? July 30, Shanghai, the heat is steaming. But what’s hotter than the weather is ChinaJoy 2026, which is about to open the next day. Just the day before Asia's largest digital entertainment event, Qualcomm held the Snapdragon Game Technology Awards on the banks of the Huangpu River - this has become one of the most important industry technology events during ChinaJoy and a fixed window for observing the gaming capabilities of the next generation mobile platform. The technological and ecological progress announced here often indicates the direction of the Android flagship mobile gaming experience in the next year. One notable shift is that the tone of this year’s technology awards has undergone profound changes. The key words of previous years were "frame rate", "energy efficiency" and "light tracing" - with hardware performance as the absolute center; this year, the fifth-generation Snapdragon 8 Extreme Edition still stands at the pinnacle of mobile SoC performance, but other important content has appeared in the big

ja.title: 「フルフレーム」から「フルスコア」へ: Snapdragon は「AI+ ゲーム」を使用してモバイル ゲームの次の黄金 10 年を促進します
ja.summary: はじめに: 「フルフレーム」が出発点になったとき、モバイル ゲームの次の終点は何でしょうか? 7月30日、上海、蒸し暑い。しかし、天気よりも暑いのは、翌日に開幕するチャイナジョイ2026です。アジア最大のデジタル エンターテインメント イベントの前日、クアルコムは黄浦江のほとりで Snapdragon Game Technology Awards を開催しました。これは ChinaJoy 期間中の最も重要な業界テクノロジー イベントの 1 つであり、次世代モバイル プラットフォームのゲーム機能を観察するための固定窓となっています。ここで発表される技術的および環境的進歩は、多くの場合、来年の Android の主力モバイル ゲーム体験の方向性を示します。注目すべき変化の 1 つは、今年のテクノロジー賞の雰囲気が大きく変わったことです。前年のキーワードは「フレーム レート」、「エネルギー効率」、「ライト トレース」であり、ハードウェアのパフォーマンスが絶対的な中心でした。今年、第 5 世代の Snapdragon 8 Extreme Edition は依然としてモバイル SoC パフォーマンスの頂点に立っていますが、他の重要なコンテンツも大きな市場に登場しています。

en.title: “Traveling with AI”: This year’s ChinaJoy included AI as its theme
en.summary: Interviews: Chen Ke'an, Gao Lingxiao, Zhou Yubo Written by: Zhou Yubo On the morning of July 31, in the Tencent game exhibition area of ​​ChinaJoy N4 Hall, an AI game creation platform called "Codename: Craft" that is still in the testing stage was placed on the booth for players to experience. Chule's editor entered a prompt: "Help me generate a cyberpunk pixel-style puzzle adventure game." A "Game Development Assistant" popped up on the screen and asked us in turn: "What is the core gameplay loop? What kind of puzzle mechanism is the main one? What is the depth of the narrative?" After answering these questions, Craft began to run on its own. Many people gathered around each computer. It takes about 20 minutes to generate. While waiting, we started to look at the AI ​​games created by other players. Most of the games on the platform are casual games. In the playable list, there is also a "second creation" option, where players can continue to modify the game through AI.

ja.title: 「AI と旅する」: 今年の ChinaJoy は AI をテーマにしました
ja.summary: インタビュー：Chen Ke'an、Gao Lingxiao、Zhou Yubo 執筆：Zhou Yubo 7月31日午前、ChinaJoy N4ホールのテンセントゲーム展示エリアでは、まだテスト段階にあるAIゲーム制作プラットフォーム「Codename: Craft」がブースに置かれ、プレイヤーが体験できるようになった。 Chule の編集者は、「サイバーパンク ピクセル スタイルのパズル アドベンチャー ゲームの生成を手伝ってください」というプロンプトを入力しました。画面上に「ゲーム開発アシスタント」が現れ、「核となるゲームプレイ ループは何ですか? 主要なパズル メカニズムは何ですか? 物語の深さは何ですか?」と順番に尋ねてきました。これらの質問に答えた後、Craft は独自に実行を開始しました。多くの人が各コンピュータの周りに集まりました。生成には約 20 分かかります。待っている間、私たちは他のプレイヤーが作成した AI ゲームを見始めました。プラットフォーム上のゲームのほとんどはカジュアル ゲームです。プレイアブル リストには、プレイヤーが AI を通じてゲームを引き続き変更できる「二次創作」オプションもあります。

en.title: Unwavering: Sony reiterates it will cancel physical disc production in early 2028
en.summary: Sony Chief Financial Officer Tao Lin reiterated during the Q&A session of the first quarter financial report of fiscal year 2026 that the company will not change its decision to stop producing PlayStation physical game discs from January 2028. It follows a surge of opposition on social media, including formal petitions and calls for a boycott. Tao Lin responded that Sony understands players’ emotions. However, the overall shift towards digitalization will not change. Tao Lin pointed out that all types of content are accelerating digitization, and the general trend of the entire gaming industry is the main factor in Sony's decision. The company has made a long-term and prudent evaluation and will steadily advance this transformation. Since the game holds fond memories for so many people, she understands these sentiments from the community. Looking to the future, Sony will focus on how to continue to attract players in a purely digital ecosystem. Tao Lin also emphasized that discs are not the key to differentiating PlayStation from PC.

ja.title: 揺るぎない：ソニーは2028年初めに物理ディスクの生産を中止すると繰り返し表明
ja.summary: ソニーの最高財務責任者タオ・リン氏は、2026会計年度第1四半期財務報告の質疑応答の中で、同社が2028年1月からプレイステーションの物理ゲームディスクの生産を停止するという決定を変更するつもりはないと繰り返した。これは、正式な嘆願書やボイコットの呼びかけなど、ソーシャルメディア上での反対の高まりを受けてのものである。タオ・リン氏は、ソニーはプレイヤーの感情を理解していると答えた。ただし、デジタル化への全体的な移行は変わりません。 Tao Lin氏は、あらゆる種類のコンテンツでデジタル化が加速しており、ゲーム業界全体の一般的な傾向がソニーの決定の主な要因であると指摘した。当社は長期的かつ慎重な評価を行い、この変革を着実に推進していきます。このゲームには多くの人にとって懐かしい思い出があるため、彼女はコミュニティのこうした感情を理解しています。将来を見据えて、ソニーは純粋なデジタルエコシステムでプレーヤーを引き付け続ける方法に焦点を当てます。 Tao Lin氏はまた、PlayStationとPCを区別する鍵はディスクではないと強調した。

On the last day of the world's destruction, the Dinos (a highly intelligent dinosaur species set in the plot), who are set to follow absolute rationality, led by their king, launched a charge against the final boss, ORT, in order to protect Chaldea who came to "destroy their world". But in the short time they spent with the Chaldeans, they understood the imperfections of the human species and fell in love with the emotions brought about by this imperfection. So they decided to abandon reason and decide to act on emotion. In the end, this sacrifice moved Kukulkan so much that he transformed the false sun into the true god. en.title: 2026 CIGDC AI Technology Reconstructing Game Industry Ecosystem Sub-forum was successfully held
en.summary: On July 29, 2026, the China International Game Developers Conference (CIGDC) "AI Technology Reconstructs the Game Industry Ecosystem Sub-Forum" was held in the grand ballroom on the first floor of Hyatt Hotel on the Bund in Shanghai. This sub-forum is hosted by the Game Publishing Working Committee of the China Audiovisual and Digital Publishing Association. It focuses on the application and future trends of AI in games. en.title: Foreign developers, break into Xiaohongshu
en.summary: At 10 pm, Erik works the night shift in an American supermarket, and his work will last until 6 am the next morning. He is responsible for putting food on the shelves at night. He will first go to the warehouse, use a manual trailer to drag the boards of pre-packaged food into the store, unbox them, and replenish the goods in each aisle. Then he will pick up the cardboard boxes on the ground, count the damaged goods, and then move the goods on the shelves forward one by one. The job is very repetitive. During this period he had two fifteen-minute breaks and one thirty-minute "lunch" period. But in Erik's opinion, repetition is a good thing: he has enough time to think about creative matters. Erik works in the warehouse of a large supermarket in the United States. Erik is the developer of "The Endless Empty" and "A Chamber of Stars". Both indie games feature music as a theme and adopt a surreal and collage art style.

en.summary: When a large-scale disaster occurs, those in charge of disaster response are forced to make decisions immediately after the disaster, including situations that were not anticipated in the disaster prevention plan established in advance. At the same time, the following game trials will also be available on site: astragon Construction Simulator: Evolution, an immersive experience of the joy of a civil engineering boss; Bus Simulator 27, an immersive experience of a day in the life of a bus driver; Fire Simulator: The Flame Is Burning, an immersive experience of the life of a firefighter

en.title: "League of Legends Mobile" celebrates its fourth anniversary, the canyon is not only in the game
en.summary: Unconsciously, "League of Legends Mobile Game" ushered in its fourth anniversary celebration. I can still clearly remember the first day when "League of Legends Mobile" was launched. After a long wait for an appointment, I effortlessly gathered five friends to play from the afternoon to midnight. In four years, "League of Legends Mobile Game" has been integrated into my life and has become an old friend of mine. Sometimes I would play more than a dozen games in a day, or I might not click on the game for weeks, and then I would inadvertently return to the canyon because of a friend’s call—but it had never disappeared from my phone. When I learned that "League of Legends Mobile" would hold its 4th anniversary celebration and summer finals at the West Bund Dream Center in Shanghai on July 25, I came to the scene with great interest. The statue of Jinx VS Blitzcrank caused people to check in and take photos at the scene. The sun was shining brightly, and the temperature by the Huangpu River reached 36°C. To be honest, this was really not a suitable place to be indoors.

ja.title: 「リーグ・オブ・レジェンド モバイル」が4周年を迎える、渓谷はゲームの中だけではない
ja.summary: 知らず知らずのうちに、「リーグ・オブ・レジェンド モバイル ゲーム」は 4 周年記念式典の幕開けを迎えました。 『リーグ・オブ・レジェンド モバイル』がローンチされた初日のことは今でも鮮明に覚えています。約束を長く待った後、私は楽々と友人 5 人を集めて、午後から真夜中まで遊びました。 4 年間で、「リーグ オブ レジェンド モバイル ゲーム」は私の生活に溶け込み、私の古い友人になりました。時には 1 日に十数のゲームをプレイしたり、何週間もゲームをクリックしなかったのに、友人からの電話でうっかり峡谷に戻ってしまうこともありましたが、そのゲームが携帯電話から消えることはありませんでした。 「リーグ オブ レジェンド モバイル」が 7 月 25 日に上海の西外灘ドリーム センターで 4 周年祝賀会と夏の決勝戦を開催すると知り、非常に興味深く現場に足を運びました。ジンクス VS ブリッツクランクの銅像が設置されると、人々は現場にチェックインして写真を撮るようになりました。太陽は明るく輝いており、黄浦江沿いの気温は36℃に達しました。正直に言うと、ここは屋内に入るにはあまり適した場所ではありませんでした。

en.title: A game and the world heritage behind it
en.summary: ■ Make history playable Today (July 25), the 48th World Heritage Conference officially included “Jingdezhen Handmade Porcelain Remains” in the World Heritage List. So far, the total number of world heritage items in my country has reached 61. In the traditional understanding, the application for World Heritage has nothing to do with games, but this time it is different. At the site of this World Heritage application event, a game called "Digital Jingdezhen·Porcelain City Craftsman" was also launched. This official mini-game is jointly produced by Jingdezhen, Tencent Games, Tencent SSV and other institutions. The mission of this game is, first of all, to better demonstrate the value and concept of "Jingdezhen Handmade Porcelain Relics" to the outside world based on the understanding and suggestions of experts applying for World Heritage. Then, in a longer time dimension, it will also promote and introduce this concept to a wider user group. In-game scene map Tu Ming is the producer of this game. He works in the pre-research team of the game AI engine department of Tencent Games. Probably around 202

en.title: Research results show that the brain can be rewired to achieve 'true multitasking'

A research team led by Maximilian Riesenhuber of Georgetown University and Patrick Cox of Lehigh University investigated how the processing pathways in the brain and the ability to perform simultaneous tasks change when practicing a single task for a long period of time. read more...

en.title: There is no legend in this world that can be easily recreated: "Halo: Campaign Evolved" review
en.summary: I often talk to my friends about how amazing I was when I first saw Halo 4. When you have experienced a thrilling battle in the cave and passed through the dark tunnel, a hole suddenly opens up in front of you - as the halo in front of you dissipates, what you see is: huge ancient civilization buildings soaring into the sky; alien fleets in the distance shuttle back and forth; huge spaceships nearby are emitting thick smoke... At that moment, I felt that what was displayed on the screen was simply a huge landscape art that could never be presented in reality. But whenever I talk about this part, I will be interrupted by those old fans of the Halo series: "Hold on hold on, buddy, are you so excited to play "Halo 4"? Then you must experience the charm of the old "Halo" for yourself." But I am ashamed to say that over the years, no matter what kind of remake Halo has gone through, for me, the graphics performance, special effects, and even operating habits of the original "Campaign Evolved" have always been the same.

ja.title: この世に簡単に再現できる伝説はない：「Halo: Campaign Evolved」レビュー

en.title: Vol.129 Swinging Listening Party: Compared with Southwest Mandarin, rap in these dialects is more noteworthy
en.summary: Guest: BrusH cover/editing/post-production: Ac Chinese hip-hop in 2026 has entered the so-called "big dialect era". Matching rap music with hometown dialect is nothing new. In addition to the uneven content accompanying the increase in entropy, the compatibility between different dialects and rap is always a topic for discussion. The combination of dialect and flow is the cornerstone of the listening experience of dialect rap, and it is also an important part of testing the musician's ability to understand and present. In this episode, three anchors and guest Brush listen to songs together - we have selected dialect rap works from six different regions in the past 1-2 years. These dialects are not common in the hip-hop market, and some are even not favored. However, the creators have achieved the organic combination of dialects and flow in different ways and angles, and they have also produced results that are quite worthy of appreciation. Let's go into this program together and see what other dialect raps there are besides the Southwest Mandarin that everyone is more accustomed to.

ja.title: Vol.129 スウィンギングリスニングパーティー: 西南北京語と比較して、これらの方言のラップはより注目に値します
ja.summary: ゲスト：BrusH カバー・編集・ポストプロダクション：Ac 2026年の中国ヒップホップは、いわゆる「大方言時代」に突入した。ラップミュージックと地元の方言を組み合わせるのは、何も新しいことではありません。エントロピー増大に伴う内容の偏りに加え、方言とラップの相性も常に話題となる。方言とフロウの組み合わせは、方言ラップのリスニング体験の基礎であり、ミュージシャンの理解力と表現力をテストする重要な部分でもあります。この回では、キャスター3名とゲストのBrushが一緒に歌を聴きます。過去1～2年に6つの地域から集めた方言ラップ作品をセレクトしました。これらの方言はヒップホップ市場では一般的ではなく、好まれないものもあります。しかし、作り手は方言と流れの有機的な結合をさまざまな方法や角度で実現しており、十分に評価に値する成果も生み出している。一緒にこのプログラムに参加して、誰もが慣れ親しんでいる南西北京語以外にどのような方言ラップがあるのか​​見てみましょう。

en.title: Weird story: If it’s a rainy night, a cucumber
en.summary: He is very fond of weird things, and talks about nonsense, ghost things, and new things related to games every day. Ronaldinho's drawings are becoming more and more amazing (Photo / Ronaldinho) There are two rows of cucumbers, two rows of eggplants and two rows of kale planted in my vegetable garden. Kale was infested with pests a while ago. The cabbage caterpillars first ate the leaves into poles before being killed by imidacloprid, and then ate the poles into mounds. Fortunately, for some unknown biological reasons, they are only obsessed with these two rows of eggplants, which are twenty centimeters apart. They are good-looking and have no bug holes. There is a red maple outside the vegetable garden. It is nothing special, but there is a cucumber hanging on it. The cucumber climbed up on its own. It passed first the wooden frame, then the holly bush, and finally reached the fork of red maple branches. There is only one plant, with fan-shaped leaves and curly vines mixed in with the maple leaves, red and green crowded together. After a few days, a white cucumber appeared on it. It looked ten centimeters in diameter. I didn’t understand how the slender vine could carry nutrients to three meters.

ja.title: 奇妙な話: 雨の夜ならキュウリ
ja.summary: 変なものが大好きで、くだらない話や幽霊の話、ゲーム関連の新ネタなどを日々語っています。ロナウジーニョの絵はますます素晴らしくなっています（写真／ロナウジーニョ） うちの家庭菜園にはキュウリが２列、ナスが２列、ケールが２列植えられています。少し前にケールに害虫が発生しました。キャベツの毛虫は、イミダクロプリドによって殺される前に、まず葉を食べて柱にし、次にその柱を食べて塚にしました。幸いなことに、いくつかの未知の生物学的理由により、彼らは20センチメートル離れたこれら2列のナスにのみ執着します。見た目も良く、虫穴もありません。菜園の外には赤もみじがあります。何の変哲もないのですが、キュウリがぶら下がっています。キュウリが勝手に登ってきました。最初に木枠を通り、次にヒイラギの茂みを通り、最後に赤カエデの枝の分岐点に達しました。赤と緑がひしめき合うカエデの葉に、扇形の葉と縮れた蔓が混じり、一株だけある。数日後、白いキュウリが現れました。直径10センチくらいあったように見えました。細い蔓がどのようにして栄養を3メートルまで運ぶことができるのか、私には理解できませんでした。

en.title: Succeeded in moving "DOOM" only with regular expressions, it took about 180 seconds to draw one frame
en.summary: Programmer Artem Litkin has released a project called ``DOOM on regex'' that runs the masterpiece FPS ``DOOM'' using only ``regular expressions'' used to search and replace strings. DOOM on regex stores everything from registers, RAM, frame buffers, DOOM itself, and WAD data into one string of approximately 96.6 MB, and builds a virtual computer that operates with only 544 replacement rules. To draw one frame of DOOM screen, approximately 13.99 million replacements are required in parallel processing by five machines, and the required time is about 180 seconds. read more...

zh.title: 仅用正则表达式成功移动“DOOM”，绘制一帧大约需要180秒
zh.summary: 程序员 Artem Litkin 发布了一个名为“DOOM on regex”的项目，该项目仅使用用于搜索和替换字符串的“正则表达式”来运行杰作 FPS“DOOM”。 DOOM on regex 将寄存器、RAM、帧缓冲区、DOOM 本身和 WAD 数据等所有内容存储到一个大约 96.6 MB 的字符串中，并构建了一台仅使用 544 条替换规则运行的虚拟计算机。绘制一帧《DOOM》画面，需要五台机器并行处理约1399万次替换，所需时间约为180秒。阅读更多...

en.summary: Capcom recently announced its latest quarterly financial report for this fiscal year. Net sales of the digital content business reached 54.648 billion yen (a year-on-year increase of 83.0%), and operating profit was 37.597 billion yen (a year-on-year increase of 87.5%). The total sales of games across all platforms increased from 14.16 million copies in the same period last year to 23.81 million copies (a year-on-year increase of 68.15%). Capcom pointed out that the sales of many titles have boosted its performance. Among them, the sales volume of "Resident Evil 9 Requiem" exceeded 8 million copies, and the sales volume of "Conscious Existence" exceeded 2.5 million copies. At the same time, the cumulative sales of "Devil May Cry 5" exceeded 14 million copies, which is also inseparable from the cross-platform strategy and animation promotion. At the same time, net sales of the arcade operating business were 6.762 billion yen, a year-on-year increase of 20.6%, but operating profit fell 4.4% to 899 million yen. en.title: Roguelike card-building game “Nightmare Card” is scheduled to be released on August 19
en.summary: The roguelike card-building game "Nightmare Card" developed by Soneka Games is scheduled to be released on August 19. In this game that blends strategy, occultism, and psychology, players delve into the world of dreams. In the game against the nightmare, cleverly use the card effects and chain reactions to finally win. <For embedded content, please go to the core to view it> It is reported that the player's goal is to accumulate "awareness points" at each purchase stage. These points will help you enter a lucid dream state and defeat your inner demons in your dreams. As long as you defeat your inner demon in 7 consecutive nights, you can completely get rid of it - but be careful: if you fail once, the nightmare will come back to bite you everything. The cards symbolize the people and actions you come into contact with during the day. At night, these cards will reappear in dreams, with unexpected and bizarre interweavings between characters and behaviors, creating an absurd but real dream narrative.

en.title: "Stalker 2: Heart of Chernobyl" "The Price of Hope" DLC will be released on August 20
en.summary: GSC Game World announced that the "Price of Hope" DLC for "Stalker 2: Heart of Chernobyl" will be released on August 20. Let this epic non-linear expansion take you into the mutation zone and launch a new scientific investigation. Dozens of hours of gameplay, filled with unforgettable plot and twisted and complex characters. Everything is shrouded in that iconic atmosphere of decadence, but at the same time there is a glimmer of hope. <For embedded content, please go to the core to view it> The developer said that the player's choice will change everything, shaping the ending, as well as the journey itself. The fragile peace between the two old enemies is shattered, and a tangled web of intrigue and half-truths becomes woven. Players need to choose the side you support. Here, there is no real right or wrong. The Chernobyl nuclear power plant, which has been sealed off for decades, now calls to stalkers. Travel through the maze-like iron forest and enter the never-before-seen

ja.title: 『Stalker 2: Heart of Chernobyl』「The Price of Hope」DLCは8月20日にリリース予定
ja.summary: GSC Game World は、「Stalker 2: Heart of Chernobyl」の DLC「Price of Hope」が 8 月 20 日にリリースされることを発表しました。この壮大な非線形拡張であなたを突然変異ゾーンに連れて行き、新しい科学的調査を開始しましょう。忘れられないプロットとひねくれた複雑なキャラクターで満たされた数十時間のゲームプレイ。すべてが退廃の象徴的な雰囲気に包まれていますが、同時に希望の光もあります。 <埋め込みコンテンツについては、コアに移動して表示してください> 開発者は、プレイヤーの選択がすべてを変え、結末だけでなく旅自体も形作ると述べました。 2 つの宿敵の間のもろい平和は打ち砕かれ、陰謀と半真実が絡み合った網が織り込まれていく。プレイヤーはどちらのチームをサポートするかを選択する必要があります。ここには、本当の善悪はありません。数十年にわたって封鎖されてきたチェルノブイリ原子力発電所では、今、ストーカーが呼び掛けている。迷路のような鉄の森を抜け、誰も見たことのない世界へ

en.title: "Tomb Raider: Ruins of Atlantis" and "Tomb Raider: Catalyst" both confirmed to be delayed
en.summary: Amazon Games head Jeffrey Gatti confirmed in an interview that both Tomb Raider games will be delayed. Not only was "Tomb Raider: Ruins of Atlantis" originally scheduled to be released in 2026 postponed to 2027, but "Tomb Raider: Catalyst" originally scheduled to be released in 2027 was postponed to 2028. In addition to avoiding competition with "GTA 6," Jeffrey Gatti said the arrangement is partly to help Amazon's game streaming platform Luna accumulate a content brand image. At the same time, the delay to 2028 means that Tomb Raider: Catalyst will not be released until after PlayStation's deadline to stop suppressing physical discs. In Tomb Raider: Ruins of Atlantis, players can relive Lara Croft's first adventure in a stunning reimagining

ja.title: 「トゥームレイダー：アトランティスの遺跡」と「トゥームレイダー：カタリスト」は両方とも延期されることが確認
ja.summary: Amazon Games の責任者である Jeffrey Gatti はインタビューの中で、Tomb Raider の両ゲームが延期されることを認めました。当初2026年にリリース予定だった「トゥームレイダー：アトランティスの遺跡」が2027年に延期されただけでなく、当初2027年にリリース予定だった「トゥームレイダー：カタリスト」も2028年に延期された。ジェフリー・ガッティ氏は、「GTA 6」との競合を回避することに加え、この取り決めの一部はアマゾンのゲームストリーミングプラットフォームであるルナのコンテンツブランドイメージの蓄積を助けるためだと述べた。同時に、2028 年への延期は、物理ディスクの抑制を停止する PlayStation の期限が過ぎるまで、『Tomb Raider: Catalyst』がリリースされないことを意味します。トゥーム レイダー: アトランティスの遺跡では、プレイヤーはララ クロフトの最初の冒険を見事な再想像で追体験できます。

en.title: "Strike: Zero Point" will open early access on Steam this Thursday
en.summary: The first-person shooter game "Strike: Zero Point" created by NEXON will be available for early access on Steam on July 30. It is reported that "Assault Storm: Zero Point" provides fast and action-packed battles, allowing everyone to directly enjoy the exciting game experience without wasting time and fully feel the passion of battle. With an extensive weapon customization system, players can create the perfect firearm to suit their playstyle. Whether it's recoil, reload speed or appearance, all gun accessories can be customized according to personal preferences. Through weapon customization, even the same weapon can bring a unique combat experience and enjoy more diverse combat fun. The developers say teamwork and tactics are key to defeating your enemies. Every battle requires precise execution and good communication to ensure victory. In addition to the exciting Bomb Defusal mode, there are a variety of other game modes coming soon

ja.title: 「Strike: Zero Point」は今週木曜日に Steam で早期アクセスを開始します
ja.summary: NEXON制作の一人称視点シューティングゲーム『Strike: Zero Point』は、7月30日にSteamで早期アクセスが開始されます。『Assault Storm: Zero Point』は、スピーディーでアクション満載の戦闘を提供し、誰もが時間を無駄にすることなくエキサイティングなゲーム体験を直接楽しみ、戦闘の情熱を十分に感じることができると報告されています。広範な武器カスタマイズ システムにより、プレイヤーは自分のプレイスタイルに合わせて完璧な銃器を作成できます。反動、リロード速度、外観など、すべての銃のアクセサリは個人の好みに応じてカスタマイズできます。武器のカスタマイズにより、同じ武器でも独自の戦闘体験をもたらし、より多様な戦闘の楽しみを楽しむことができます。開発者らは、敵を倒すにはチームワークと戦術が鍵となると述べている。すべての戦闘では、勝利を確実にするために正確な実行と良好なコミュニケーションが必要です。エキサイティングな爆弾解除モードに加えて、他のさまざまなゲームモードも近日登場予定です

en.title: When “super companies” are forced to “talk politics”: Industry has become the main battlefield for competition among major powers
en.summary: From the "CEO group" that accompanied Trump on his visit to China, to the recent dramatic fluctuations in the stock prices of chip and AI giants... giant multinational companies are now deeply embedded in the game of great powers and cannot stay out of geopolitics. The era of "industrial politics" in which industry and politics are deeply bound and mutually shaped has arrived. The guest in this issue, Professor Li Wei, has focused on studying the complex linkage between “super enterprises” and domestic and international politics of various countries in recent years. In this episode, Mr. Li Wei sorted out the ups and downs and different situations of the focal "super companies" in different countries in recent years, presenting us with the political and economic logic behind the rise and fall of various countries' industries in the past two decades, and also providing a more economic-based perspective for understanding the still-evolving competition between major powers. Guests in this issue: Li Wei, professor at the School of International Relations, Renmin University of China, recent author of "Industrial Politics: Super Enterprises and Great Power Competition" Host: Zheng Tao, editor of "Cultural Perspectives" 00:44 Why study today

ja.title: 「スーパー企業」が「政治の発言」を迫られるとき：産業界は大国間の競争の主戦場となっている
ja.summary: トランプ大統領の中国訪問に同行した「CEOグループ」から、最近の半導体・AI大手の株価の劇的な変動まで…巨大多国籍企業は今や大国のゲームに深く組み込まれており、地政学から離れることはできない。産業と政治が深く結びつき、相互に形成していく「産業政治」の時代が到来した。今回のゲストであるリー・ウェイ教授は、近年、「スーパー企業」と各国の国内・国際政治との複雑な関係の研究に注力してきました。今回のエピソードでは、リー・ウェイ氏が近年の各国の注目の「スーパー企業」の栄枯盛衰とさまざまな状況を整理し、過去20年間の各国産業の隆盛と衰退の背後にある政治経済的論理を提示し、さらに進化を続ける大国間の競争を理解するためのより経済に基づいた視点を提供してくれた。この号のゲスト：李偉、中国人民大学国際関係学院教授、『産業政治：超大企業と大国の競争』の最近の著者 司会者：鄭濤、『文化的展望』編集者 00:44 なぜ今日勉強するのか

en.title: To a new world, to a reciprocal future: Notes after viewing the "To a New World" tour concert of "Ming Tide"
en.summary: I still remember that after participating in the "Curo Game Carnival" last year, I wrote this sentence in my review article: This year's carnival is a bit conservative. Next year, I will try to hold it for three days. By the way, I will also put a special concert on the agenda. I really can't get enough of it live, please! Then Kuro really did it this year. In fact, it is not so much that Cullo "listened to the advice", but rather "resulted from the public's expectation" - "The Singing Tide" is now preparing to move towards its fourth major version, and has accumulated so many divine songs as "May Dai Rongguang Fall into the Abyss", "Farewell of the Voyage Star" and "Reignited from the Embers", but it only contributed a small performance at last year's carnival that left much to be desired. I still remember that the players in the field had only one reaction: not enough, not enough, not enough. When Cullo officially announced that he would start a global tour in Shanghai, Tokyo, Singapore, Los Angeles and other places, I even felt a little "dreamy" - from the few dozen minutes of L at the carnival

ja.title: 新しい世界へ、互恵的な未来へ：「明潮」ツアーコンサート「To a New World」鑑賞後のメモ
ja.summary: 昨年の「クロゲームカーニバル」に参加した後、レビュー記事でこんな一文を書いたのを今でも覚えています：今年のカーニバルはちょっと保守的です。来年は3日間開催してみます。ちなみに、スペシャルコンサートも予定に入れておきます。ライブでは本当にたまりません、お願いします！そしてクロは今年本当にやってくれました。実際、クッロは「アドバイスに耳を傾けた」というよりも、むしろ「大衆の期待の結果」だった。「The Singing Tide」は現在、4度目のメジャー・ヴァージョンに向けて準備を進めており、「May Dai Rongguang Fall into the Abyss」、「Farewell of the Voyage Star」、「Reignited from the Ember」など数多くの神曲を蓄積しているが、昨年のカーニバルでの小さなパフォーマンスに貢献しただけだ。望まれることがたくさん残されています。フィールドの選手たちの反応はただひとつ、「足りない、足りない、足りない」だったのを今でも覚えています。クッロが上海、東京、シンガポール、ロサンゼルスなどで世界ツアーを開始すると正式に発表したとき、私はカーニバルでの数十分の「L」から、少し「夢見心地」さえ感じた。

en.title: "The Battle of the Golden Shovel" has updated the already "conferred" season again
en.summary: On July 23, the first day of the update of the "League of Legends Hex Codex" version of "Spade War", I played a game of Shadow Island Foego. In the last season, Shadow Island was a medium-strength lineup that could barely get a ranking with 3-star Foego. Even if Thresh was unlocked later, the upper limit of combat power was not considered the top level. Relying on 3-star Foego, I spent the early and mid-term with ten consecutive victories. At this time, two lineups had begun to take shape, and I started to turn from a winning streak to a losing streak. According to previous experience, I can guarantee that this one will be in the top four at most, but after the update, Shadow Island has added two new "city-state keys" that have prerequisites to unlock. Each key will have certain attributes and special effects attached. I noticed that the powerful bonus brought by the golden "Technology Key" is likely to be the key to my sprint to the top. I gradually realized the importance of the new mechanism. After enduring the last wave of fault tolerance and going to level 10 to get the key, the game changed. Let's start the war

ja.title: 「ゴールデンシャベルの戦い」は、すでに「授与された」シーズンを再び更新しました
ja.summary: 『リーグ・オブ・レジェンド ヘックスコーデックス』版『スペードウォー』アップデート初日の7月23日、影の島フォエゴをプレイしてみました。昨シーズンのShadow Islandは、星3のフォエゴと並ぶのがやっとの中堅陣容だった。後からスレッシュが解放されても戦闘力の上限はトップレベルとは言えなかった。 ３つ星フォエゴを頼りに１０連勝で前期、中期を過ごした。この頃は２つの布陣が形になり始め、連勝から連敗に向かい始めていました。これまでの経験によれば、これは多くてもトップ 4 に入ることが保証できますが、アップデート後、Shadow Island にはロックを解除するための前提条件を持つ 2 つの新しい「都市国家キー」が追加されました。各キーには特定の属性と特殊効果が付加されます。黄金の「テクノロジーキー」がもたらす強力なボーナスが、トップへのスパートの鍵となりそうなことに気づいた。新しい仕組みの重要性が徐々に分かってきました。フォールト トレランスの最後の波に耐え、レベル 10 に進んでキーを入手した後、ゲームは変わりました。戦争を始めましょう

en.title: Weird story: Cut a game of "Civilization 6" into fifteen minutes
en.summary: He is very fond of weird things, and talks about nonsense, ghost things, and new things related to games every day. Teacher Xiao Luo’s picture today is really both physical and spiritual! I have almost forgotten the last time I played Civilization 6. This game takes too long and there are too many things to learn and remember. Leadership abilities, area adjacency bonuses, technology and municipal Eureka, and the restraint relationship between different arms. If you play a little more seriously, you need to constantly check the strategy and calculations. What's more troublesome is that it can easily give people the illusion of "sleep after playing this round". Sometimes I just want to explore the city a little before going to bed, and when I wake up, it’s already 3am. It’s hard for me to say that I’m an entry-level Civilization player. I don’t have the ambition to become a top player in Civilization 6, and I don’t even have the courage to play PVP. I don’t dare to adjust the difficulty too high even for humans and machines. It’s not that I’m not interested in games between people at all. I just don't have the courage

ja.title: 奇妙な話: 「Civilization 6」のゲームを 15 分に短縮する
ja.summary: 変なものが大好きで、くだらない話や幽霊の話、ゲーム関連の新ネタなどを日々語っています。今日のシャオ・ルオ先生の写真は、本当に肉体的かつ精神的なものです。最後に Civilization 6 をプレイしたのがいつだったかほとんど忘れています。このゲームは時間がかかりすぎ、学ばなければならないことや覚えなければならないことが多すぎます。リーダーシップ能力、エリア隣接ボーナス、テクノロジーと自治体エウレカ、そして異なる武器間の拘束関係。もう少し真剣にプレイする場合は、常に戦略と計算を確認する必要があります。さらに厄介なのは、「このラウンドをプレイしたら寝る」​​という錯覚を与えやすいことだ。寝る前に少しだけ街を散策したいと思うことがありますが、目が覚めるともう午前3時になっています。私は、Civilization の初心者プレイヤーであるとは言いがたいです。私にはシヴィライゼーション 6 でトッププレイヤーになるという野心はありませんし、PVP をプレイする勇気もありません。人間でも機械でも、あえて難易度を上げすぎないようにしています。私は人間同士のゲームにまったく興味がないわけではありません。ただ勇気がないだけです

en.title: A newspaper, a strange case, how "City of Silver" allows players to become detectives
en.summary: "Do you want to confirm that this inference is the truth of the case and make it public?" Faced with this prompt, I hesitated. After more than an hour of investigation, questioning and evidence collection, I have deduced the suspect in the case based on the clues in my hand. However, there are still several doubts that have not been fully resolved, which makes me a little unsure whether my conclusion is the "truth". This is a mission with a branching ending. Once the player makes a mistake, they can only "go back" and deduce it again until the case is over. So, when the game prompted me to bear the "consequences" of my next choices, at that moment I seemed to have really become a detective, rather than a viewer who kept clicking the mouse according to the task prompts. This kind of experience is difficult to find in previous two-dimensional games. There is only one truth! Today, the new game "City of Silver" developed by Le Elements officially started its "dichotomy test". What I just mentioned is the new strange case investigation branch "Dead Body Su" in the second beta.

ja.title: 新聞、奇妙な事件、「City of Silver」でプレイヤーが探偵になれる仕組み
ja.summary: 「この推理が事件の真実であることを確認し、公表しますか？」このプロンプトに直面して、私は躊躇しました。 1時間以上の捜査、尋問、証拠収集を経て、私は手元にある手がかりに基づいて事件の容疑者を推理しました。しかし、まだ完全に解決されていないいくつかの疑問があり、私の結論が「真実」であるかどうかは少し自信がありません。エンディング分岐のあるミッションです。プレイヤーが間違いを犯すと、事件が終わるまで「戻って」再度推理することしかできません。したがって、ゲームが私に次の選択の「結果」に耐えるよう促したとき、その瞬間、私はタスクの指示に従ってマウスをクリックし続ける視聴者ではなく、本当に探偵になったように思えました。この種の体験は、これまでの 2D ゲームでは見つけることが困難です。真実は一つしかない！本日、Le Elements開発の新作ゲーム『City of Silver』が正式に「二項対立テスト」を開始しました。先ほどお話ししたのは、第2期ベータ版の新たな怪事件捜査支部「死体蘇」です。

en.title: Strange tales of touching music: cutting and doing at the same time
en.summary: He is very fond of weird things, and talks about nonsense, ghost things, and new things related to games every day. Teacher Xiao Luo’s picture today is really both physical and spiritual! Since early July, Xbox’s massive layoffs have caused huge shocks in the overseas gaming industry. According to public reports, "Microsoft plans to lay off about 3,200 people in the Xbox department and spin off five of its game studios as part of a business restructuring. This adjustment aims to reduce the size of the content and development team, focus on core games and services, and optimize the cost structure." According to follow-up news, most of Microsoft's first-party studios have laid off about 20% of their employees. ZeniMax, Bethesda, Obsidian Entertainment, etc. are all affected, and the blockbuster IPs involved include the "Doom", "The Elder Scrolls", "Fallout" series, etc. What is incredible is that this layoff did not affect grassroots or outsourced employees as people usually imagine, but instead affected quite a lot of people.

ja.title: 音楽に触れる奇妙な物語: カットと演奏を同時に行う
ja.summary: 変なものが大好きで、くだらない話や幽霊の話、ゲーム関連の新ネタなどを日々語っています。今日のシャオ・ルオ先生の写真は、本当に肉体的かつ精神的なものです。 7月初旬以来、Xboxの大規模な人員削減は海外のゲーム業界に大きな衝撃を与えている。公開報道によると、「マイクロソフトは、事業再構築の一環として、Xbox部門の約3,200人を解雇し、ゲームスタジオ5つをスピンオフする予定だ。この調整は、コンテンツと開発チームの規模を縮小し、中核となるゲームとサービスに集中し、コスト構造を最適化することを目的としている。」とのこと。続報によると、Microsoftのファーストパーティスタジオのほとんどが従業員の約20％を解雇したという。 ZeniMax、Bethesda、Obsidian Entertainment などがすべて影響を受けており、関与した大ヒット IP には、「Doom」、「The Ellder Scrolls」、「Fallout」シリーズなどが含まれます。信じられないのは、この一時解雇が一般に想像されているような草の根や外注従業員に影響を与えたのではなく、むしろかなり多くの人々に影響を与えたことです。

en.title: Exclusive interview with Chen Xinghan: What "Light·Encounter" has been doing from the beginning has become more important now
en.summary: On July 17, "Light·Encounter" updated the new season "Dear Van Gogh". This is the anniversary version of the Chinese version of "Light·Encounter" celebrating its seventh anniversary. It is also the version of "Light·Encounter" that has performed best on the list in the past three months: on the first day of the season's launch, the game's ranking on the best-selling list increased significantly, and it ranked fifth on the best-selling list the next day. In fact, the "To Van Gogh" season chosen by "Light·Encounter" is not a flattering theme, and there are certain difficulties in the expression of the unique style and the tone of the story. From a narrative perspective, the content it tells is not unknown to most previous players: it is not only about the famous painter Vincent Van Gogh, but also spends a lot of space telling the story of his brother Theo Van Gogh and sister-in-law Joanna Van Gogh. However, during this period, if you pay attention to the player community of "Light Encounter", you will find that most players are immersed in the story about Van Gogh. Although many players will express

en.title: From myth to fantasy: "Ancient Sword" is played offline for the first time, let's talk about its philosophy and ambitions
en.summary: On July 18, Chule was invited to the Shanghai Art Museum (China Art Palace) to participate in the first large-scale offline trial session held by Shanghai Zhulong Studio for "Ancient Sword". "Gu Jian" is the orthodox sequel to the "Gu Jian Qi Tan" series. It is also an ARPG that combines elements of ancient myths and legends. It is currently in the middle of project development. Players need to play the role of "Judge of the Realm" in the game, go to places of disorder in the world to restrain wandering souls, resolve cause and effect, and resolve obsessions. The trial site restored the "Changshengju" inn in the game, with golden leaves covering the ground, and Nuo masks and ink portraits hanging along the walls. The "Gu Jian Qi Tan" series relies on its extremely excellent narrative level, character creation and unique oriental fantasy style to accumulate a group of loyal players. "Gu Jian Qi Tan III" is regarded by many as the "ceiling of domestic stand-alone RPGs" in recent years. Therefore, "Ancient Sword" has attracted a large number of players since its first trailer was released in August 2025.

ja.title: 神話からファンタジーへ：『Ancient Sword』を初めてオフラインでプレイ、その哲学と野望を語ろう
ja.summary: 7月18日、Chuleさんは上海美術館（チャイナ・アート・パレス）に招待され、上海Zhulong Studioが開催した「Ancient Sword」の初の大規模オフライン体験会に参加した。 『Gu Jian』は、『Gu Jian Qi Tan』シリーズの正統続編です。古代の神話と伝説の要素を組み合わせた ARPG でもあります。現在、プロジェクト開発の真っ最中です。プレイヤーはゲーム内で「王国の裁判官」の役割を果たし、世界の無秩序な場所に行き、さまよう魂を抑制し、原因と結果を解決し、強迫観念を解決する必要があります。トライアルサイトでは、ゲーム内の旅館「長生州」が復元され、金色の葉が地面を覆い、壁にはヌオの仮面や墨の肖像画が飾られていました。 「Gu Jian Qi Tan」シリーズは、その非常に優れた物語レベル、キャラクター作成、ユニークな東洋ファンタジー スタイルに依存しており、忠実なプレイヤーのグループを獲得しています。 『Gu Jian Qi Tan III』は近年の“国産スタンドアロンRPGの天井”との呼び声も高い。したがって、「Ancient Sword」は、2025 年 8 月に最初のトレーラーが公開されて以来、多くのプレイヤーを魅了してきました。

en.title: Weird story: "Raising a daughter" anytime, anywhere
en.summary: He is very fond of weird things, and talks about nonsense, ghost things, and new things related to games every day. Picture / Ronaldinho This month ( July 2) At the TapTap Game Festival game conference, the news of the national mobile version of "Sudan's Game (hereinafter referred to as "Suyou") was announced. This reminds me of the time when I was addicted to Suyou. I tried many sitting positions for hundreds of hours, trying to make myself feel better. It feels more comfortable to play. It’s still too tiring to play text games on PC, especially during the game when I have to control the protagonist Altu to go to court, please the Sultan, and solve various problems. It makes me sit in front of the computer and click the mouse furiously, giving me the illusion of working in the game. So, when my friends were all addicted to "The Fire Girl", I rejected their recommendation because "it's too tiring to sit in front of the computer and play adult games." Until recently, I was pleasantly surprised to find that the Fire Girl also has a mobile version. The mobile version is priced at 18 yuan.

ja.title: 世にも奇妙な物語 いつでもどこでも「娘の育て方」
ja.summary: 変なものが大好きで、くだらない話や幽霊の話、ゲーム関連の新ネタなどを日々語っています。写真/ロナウジーニョ 今月（7月2日）TapTap Game Festivalのゲームカンファレンスで、「Sudan's Game（以下「Suyou」）」の全国モバイル版のニュースが発表されました。これを聞くと、私がSuyouに夢中だった頃を思い出します。気分を良くするために、何百時間も座りながらいろいろ試しました。プレイするのがより快適です。PCでテキストゲームをプレイするのはまだ疲れます、特に主人公を制御しなければならないゲーム中は。アルトゥは法廷に行き、スルタンを喜ばせ、さまざまな問題を解決するため、コンピューターの前に座って猛烈にマウスをクリックし、ゲームをしているような錯覚に陥ります。そのため、友達がみんな「コンピューターの前に座ってアダルトゲームをプレイするのは疲れる」という理由で彼らの勧めを拒否していましたが、モバイル版の価格が 18 元であることを知って嬉しい驚きを感じました。

Dick Memorial Award, three major science fiction literary awards. The background of the novel is set in a dystopian future world. He has published best-selling works such as "White Night Walk" and "The Devotion of Suspect X". The official said: The stories created by Mr. Higashino Keigo will surely continue to attract many readers. Please continue to enjoy Mr. Higashino's novels in the future.

en.title: "The Thief of All Faces" stops content updates, and the development team faces major layoffs
en.summary: OtherSide Entertainment has announced that its stealth-action theft game Faceless Thief will cease all content updates. Due to poor launch performance and poor reputation, some members of the development team have resigned. Due to the extremely small size of the remaining team, it is no longer feasible to continue developing new content and systems. Developers are working on new versions of the game to keep its base running. Going forward, publisher Megabit will take over full maintenance of the game. It is reported that the new version will no longer use dedicated cloud servers, but will switch to a peer-to-peer network to support cooperative connections. This structural adjustment will not change the actual gameplay experience, and the single-player mode will not be affected at all. "Face" was developed by Warren Spector and was originally planned to be a PvPvE game. Due to multiple reasons such as the sluggish environment of the game industry and the break in the development capital chain, the final content volume of "The Thief of All Faces" was finally reduced.

ja.title: 「The Thief of All Faces」でコンテンツ更新が停止、開発チームは大規模な人員削減に直面
ja.summary: OtherSide Entertainment は、ステルス アクション盗難ゲーム Faceless Thief のすべてのコンテンツ更新を中止すると発表しました。打ち上げのパフォーマンスの悪さと評判の悪さにより、開発チームの一部のメンバーが辞任しました。残っているチームの規模が非常に小さいため、新しいコンテンツやシステムの開発を続けることはもはや不可能です。開発者は、基本動作を継続するためにゲームの新しいバージョンの開発に取り組んでいます。今後は、パブリッシャーの Megabit がゲームの完全なメンテナンスを引き継ぎます。新しいバージョンでは専用のクラウドサーバーは使用されなくなり、協調接続をサポートするためにピアツーピアネットワークに切り替わると報告されています。この構造調整は実際のゲームプレイ体験を変えるものではなく、シングルプレイヤー モードにはまったく影響しません。 「Face」はウォーレン・スペクターによって開発され、当初は PvPvE ゲームとして計画されました。ゲーム業界の低迷や開発資金チェーンの断絶などの複数の理由により、最終的に「The Thief of All Faces」の最終コンテンツ量は削減されました。

en.title: Watch ads for longer time: Xbox tests free cloud gaming service
en.summary: Microsoft has now officially begun testing a free, ad-supported cloud gaming service for Xbox Insiders. During the limited-time test period, players can stream purchased games or select games that are free on the base version at no additional cost. A single play time is limited to 1 hour, but the total time is not limited (you need to queue up again and watch ads each time). It is reported that the advertisement will only play before the game starts and will not interrupt the game process. Microsoft says players will be able to experience Xbox Series X|S games through the cloud without purchasing new hardware. Advertising-supported cloud games help lower the threshold for playing, making it easier for players in areas where consoles are harder to find or more expensive. At the same time, the team believes that reasonable advertising can lower the acquisition threshold and allow players to experience cloud games without prepayment. This trial follows the delivery principle of not interfering with the game flow, and the advertising content will remain high-quality and clearly marked. Players not participating in the program

ja.title: 広告を長時間視聴する: Xbox が無料のクラウド ゲーム サービスをテスト
ja.summary: Microsoft は、Xbox Insider 向けに、無料の広告付きクラウド ゲーム サービスのテストを正式に開始しました。期間限定のテスト期間中、プレイヤーは購入したゲームをストリーミングしたり、追加料金なしで基本バージョンで無料のゲームを選択したりできます。 1 回のプレイ時間は 1 時間に制限されていますが、合計時間には制限がありません (毎回再度列に並んで広告を見る必要があります)。報告によると、広告はゲーム開始前にのみ再生され、ゲームプロセスを中断することはありません。 Microsoftによれば、プレーヤーは新しいハードウェアを購入することなく、クラウドを通じてXbox Series X|Sのゲームを体験できるようになるという。広告付きのクラウド ゲームは、プレイの敷居を下げるのに役立ち、コンソールを見つけるのが難しい、または高価な地域のプレイヤーにとってもプレイしやすくなります。同時にチームは、合理的な広告によって獲得の敷居を下げ、プレイヤーが前払いなしでクラウド ゲームを体験できるようになると考えています。このトライアルでは、ゲーム フローを妨げないという配信原則に従っており、広告コンテンツは高品質のままで、明確にマークされます。プログラムに参加していない選手

In order to test the game experience and ensure server stability, the subscription fee will be waived for the first month of the game's release. Officially confirmed that players who already have a standard subscription to Final Fantasy 14 will need to pay an additional independent subscription fee after the first month, but do not need to purchase a Nintendo Switch Online membership. However, players who already subscribe to the standard monthly fee on other platforms can enjoy an exclusive 50% discount on the monthly fee. The entry-level plan is priced at $12.99/month, and the standard plan is priced at $14.99/month. en.title: In the "Rune Battlefield" National Open, the most important thing is not winning
en.summary: On July 19, the weather was unexpectedly good at the National Convention Center in Beijing. At 9 o'clock in the morning, the event verification area of ​​the National Convention Center was full of people. Pushing another door open, the air-conditioned air rushed in, mixed with the smell of cards and plastic card boxes. Most of the players present are young faces, rarely walking alone, and almost always surrounded by companions. They carried bags on their backs and clutched card deck boxes in their hands, discussing the gains and losses of the previous round animatedly. "Rune Fields" is a physical trading card developed by Riot Games based on the League of Legends IP. It is jointly published and operated by Soul Flash and Riot in China. The first version will be launched in the summer of 2025, and it has now advanced to its third season. What I am participating in today is the third season of the "Rune Battlefield" National Open. Official cosplayers at the scene ■ The battle began. Players at the scene told me that the first day's competition lasted from ten o'clock in the morning to nearly eleven o'clock in the evening, and the process was very hard. However, my task on the first day was relatively simple: to teach newbies

ja.summary: 7月19日、北京の国家会議センターは予想外に好天に恵まれた。朝9時、国立大会議場のイベント検証エリアは人でいっぱいだった。別のドアを押し開けると、カードやプラスチックのカード箱の匂いと混じり、空調の効いた空気が勢いよく入ってきた。参加しているプレイヤーのほとんどは若く、一人で歩くことはほとんどなく、ほとんどの場合仲間に囲まれています。彼らはバッグを背負い、手にはカードデッキの箱を握りしめ、前のラウンドの勝敗について生き生きと話し合った。 「Rune Fields」は、League of LegendsのIPをベースにRiot Gamesが開発したフィジカルトレーディングカードです。中国のSoul FlashとRiotが共同で発行・運営しています。最初のバージョンは2025年夏に開始され、現在は第3シーズンに進んでいます。今日参加するのは「ルーン戦場」全国オープンの第3シーズンです。現場にいた公式コスプレイヤーたち ■ 戦いが始まった。現場にいた選手たちの話では、初日の競技は朝の10時から夜の11時近くまで続き、とても大変だったそうです。しかし、初日の私の仕事は比較的単純で、初心者に教えるというものでした。

en.title: İpek Yavuz, co-founder of Mount and Blade developer and "mother of Mount and Blade", dies at the age of 54
en.summary: İpek Yavuz, co-founder of TaleWorlds Entertainment, the developer of Mount & Blade, passed away on July 22 at the age of 54. TaleWorlds reflected on İpek Yavuz’s early contributions in a social media post, emphasizing that her passion and vision laid the foundation for the studio. TaleWorlds was co-founded by İpek Yavuz and Armağan Yavuz in 2005 in Ankara, Türkiye. During the development phase of the first Mount & Blade, İpek Yavuz was heavily involved in visual design. It is precisely because of İpek Yavuz's contribution that the original small team gradually grew into an international game studio. Today, TaleWorlds has amassed a global following with the Mount & Blade series.

ja.title: マウント アンド ブレード開発者の共同創設者で「マウント アンド ブレードの母」イペク・ヤヴズ氏が54歳で死去
ja.summary: Mount & Blade の開発者である TaleWorlds Entertainment の共同創設者、イペク ヤヴズ氏が 7 月 22 日に 54 歳で亡くなりました。TaleWorlds はソーシャル メディアの投稿でイペク ヤヴズの初期の貢献を振り返り、彼女の情熱とビジョンがスタジオの基礎を築いたことを強調しました。 TaleWorlds は、2005 年にトゥルキエのアンカラでイペク ヤヴズとアルマアン ヤヴズによって共同設立されました。最初の Mount & Blade の開発段階では、İpek Yavuz がビジュアル デザインに深く関わっていました。もともと小さなチームが徐々に国際的なゲーム スタジオに成長したのは、まさに İpek Yavuz の貢献のおかげです。現在、TaleWorlds は Mount & Blade シリーズで世界的なファンを獲得しています。

en.title: BW "Total War: Warhammer 40,000" booth travel notes including eating and taking
en.summary: Author: Radish During this month's Shanghai BW, Sega brought "Total War: Warhammer 40K" (hereinafter referred to as Total War 40K) to the exhibition hall, and the production director of this game, Chris Toepker, was also present. Chris is a China expert who has lived in China for 20 years. His spoken Chinese is quite good, and he answered questions fluently throughout the conversations with the media without the need for an interpreter. This is Total War 40K’s first large-scale offline promotion event in the world, and it is also the first complete 6-minute live demonstration to be brought to the BW stage. These days, X and some foreign hammer guys on the Warhammer forum are quite surprised and jealous, but the mainland Chinese market is indeed too big to ignore, and the Warhammer enthusiasts and cosplayers who came to the scene are indeed full of love. It can be regarded as a successful "two-way rush". We did it right next to the platform with Chris Toepker

en.title: "Offline Translator" allows you to translate PDFs, images, EPUBs, text files, audio and camera input offline for free and without limit on your smartphone, supports 60 languages ​​and supports Japanese vertical writing
en.summary: Nowadays, with the availability of excellent translation apps, everyone is becoming able to enjoy the service of translating various languages ​​into their native language. However, in many cases, translation functionality is provided as a web app or web API, and is assumed to be online. "Offline Translator" uses the translation model of Firefox's local translation function, and once you download the language pack that includes the translation model, it is an application that allows you to translate even when you are completely offline. read more...

en.title: ``kage'' allows you to delete JavaScript on pages for free, save the entire site locally and view it offline
en.summary: Even if you save the website you are viewing in your browser, if it relies on data acquisition using JavaScript or communication with external services, the main text may not be displayed or the images and layout may be corrupted in an offline environment. "kage" is a tool that allows you to check dynamically generated content even offline by removing JavaScript after completing the page display in Chrome and saving all HTML, images, etc. locally. read more...

en.title: Tencent turned the second game into Gal Game?
en.summary: Imagine if a two-dimensional game had a built-in desktop companion function, and the character owned by the player could accompany you to study, work, and listen to music. What would it be like? At this moment, while I was writing a manuscript, the background of my computer desktop was a beautiful girl named "Akiko". She sat on the stairs nearby and read a book. Every few minutes she would put down the book in her hand, chat with me interactively, and test me with questions in the book. Of course, if you are using a mobile phone, you can also put it aside, read a book with her, and occasionally click on the screen to interact with her. This is a function in "Chasing Kaledo" that started testing yesterday (July 16). Players can unlock the "Time Flow" companion function if the characters they obtain in the game meet certain conditions. In the current test version, the "flowing time" of the two characters Sera and Akiko is open for players to experience for free for a limited time. zh.title: 推出“Bento/Slides”，这是一款幻灯片创建 Web 应用程序，可使用单个 HTML 文件在本地运行，允许与 AI 代理进行协作编辑和流畅的自动操作
zh.summary: 出现了可在 Firefox 和 Chrome 等网络浏览器上运行的免费幻灯片创建应用程序“Bento / Slides”。 Bento/Slides 的特点是不仅能够将您创建的幻灯片保存为单个 HTML 文件，还能够将“幻灯片创建功能本身”保存为单个 HTML 文件，使您无需 Internet 连接即可创建幻灯片。此外，它还设计有使用AI代理创建幻灯片的能力，并且在连接到互联网时还可以使用协作编辑功能。阅读更多...

en.title: Introducing "Bento/Slides", a slide creation web application that runs locally with a single HTML file, allows collaborative editing & smooth automatic operation with AI agent
en.summary: A free slide creation application ``Bento / Slides'' that runs on web browsers such as Firefox and Chrome has appeared. Bento/Slides is characterized by the ability to save not only the slides you create but also the "slide creation function itself" as a single HTML file, allowing you to create slides without an Internet connection. In addition, it is designed with the ability to create slides using an AI agent, and you can also use collaborative editing functions when connected to the Internet. read more...

en.title: Kimi K3 achieved second place after Fable 5 in the AI ​​agent benchmark "AA-Briefcase", but the execution cost is higher than Opus 4.8 and takes an average of nearly 1 hour per task.

zh.title: Kimi K3 在 AI 代理基准测试“AA-Briefcase”中取得了仅次于《神鬼寓言 5》的第二名，但执行成本高于 Opus 4.8，每个任务平均需要近 1 小时。

en.title: It turned out that the Rust migration version "Bun v1.4.0" was incorporated into Claude Code before the official release

en.title: Real estate registrations and transactions across Romania are halted due to cyber attack on government agency's IT infrastructure
en.summary: In July 2026, a cyber attack targeted the IT infrastructure of the Romanian National Cadastral and Land Registration Agency (ANCPI), which is responsible for cadastral management and real estate registration in Romania, effectively halting real estate registration services and real estate transactions in Romania. This incident suggests that cyberattacks on government agencies may pose a risk that could shake the entire country. read more...

ja.summary: 表紙・編集・ポストプロダクション：Ac 『カンフーガールズ』の興行収入は30億という誇張された見積もりに達しているが、完全な駄作であることは間違いない。私たちがこれまで見てきたさまざまな初期の現象を振り返ると、それが駄作であることは驚くべきことではないかもしれませんが、その質の低さの理由と、「駄作なのに儲かる」という背後にある動作メカニズムについては、まだ座って話す価値があります。スティーブン・チョウは印象的なブランド名であり、中国語映画の中で何世代にもわたって記憶されている名前です。それにもかかわらず、Ac と Lingzi は彼に対してあまり明確な印象や強い感情フィルターを持っていないようです。したがって、このエピソードでは、3 人のキャスターの中でスティーブン・チョウを追いかけ、愛しているニャー・チェンが他の 2 人に、「カンフー ガールズ」のレベル、そのルーツと原因、そしてスティーブン・チョウの実際の創作状況について共有します。さらに、みんなの口の中の「スターの匂い」とは何なのか、そしてこの独特の匂いの背後にいるスティーブン・チョウの過去についても話します。

en.title: [Rumor] The live-action series of "God of War" has changed its male protagonist, and the already filmed series has been cancelled.
en.summary: Amazon Prime Video's live-action series "God of War" has decided to replace the actor who plays the male protagonist Kratos and begin recasting, Deadline reports. The actor Ryan Hurst, who was previously confirmed to play the role, was seriously injured while filming on the set in late June. The producers Sony Pictures Television and Amazon MGM Studios finally decided to replace the actor after evaluation. The actor playing Kratos unfortunately suffered a torn bicep while filming a stunt. The crew suspended filming immediately after the accident and has not resumed work yet. It is reported that severe biceps tears usually require 4 to 6 months to recover, and it can take up to 1 year to regain full strength. Due to the heavy action scenes of Kratos, Hearst may not be ready for filming until 2027. The crew believed that the recovery period exceeded the production schedule constraints, and finally decided to recast the actors. This live-action series of "God of War" will be played by Ronald Moore

ja.title: 【噂】『ゴッド・オブ・ウォー』の実写シリーズは男性主人公が変更され、すでに撮影されていたシリーズは中止になった。
ja.summary: Amazonプライム・ビデオの実写シリーズ「ゴッド・オブ・ウォー」で、男性主人公クレイトス役の俳優を交代し、キャストの再調整を開始することが決定したとDeadlineが報じた。以前にこの役を演じることが決まっていた俳優ライアン・ハーストは、6月下旬に撮影現場で重傷を負った。プロデューサーのソニー・ピクチャーズ・テレビジョンとアマゾン・MGMスタジオは、評価を経て最終的に俳優の交代を決定した。クレイトス役の俳優はスタント撮影中に残念ながら上腕二頭筋断裂を負った。撮影スタッフは事故直後に撮影を中断し、まだ作業を再開していない。重度の上腕二頭筋断裂は通常、回復するまでに 4 ～ 6 か月かかり、完全な強度を取り戻すには最大 1 年かかる場合があると報告されています。クレイトスの激しいアクションシーンのため、ハーストは2027年まで撮影の準備が整わない可能性がある。スタッフは回復期間が制作スケジュールの制約を超えていると考え、最終的に俳優のキャストを変更することを決定した。 「ゴッド・オブ・ウォー」の実写シリーズはロナルド・ムーアが演じる

en.title: "PlayerUnknown's Battlegrounds" has implemented a new policy. Setting a secondary password can unlock it once every six months.
en.summary: "PlayerUnknown's Battlegrounds" has now implemented the latest policies. From now on, the number of times that can be unblocked in the future will depend on whether the account has a secondary password set. If a secondary password is set, each account can be unblocked once every six months (up to twice a year). At the same time, players who have not set a secondary password maintain the original standard, and their accounts can be unblocked once in their lifetime. Officials stated that while the anti-cheating team is combating cheating, it is also optimizing relevant policies to protect players who have been unfairly banned due to account theft. This will both protect players who actively use security measures and encourage players who haven't yet set up a secondary password to enable it. Officials are also preparing additional measures for accounts that were hacked before the secondary password function was launched and have already used one unblocking opportunity. If a player falls into this situation, they can submit a re-review application through the customer service center. The official will check again to confirm whether the account has been stolen.

ja.title: 「PlayerUnknown's Battlegrounds」は新しいポリシーを実装しました。 2 番目のパスワードを設定すると、6 か月に 1 回ロックを解除できます。
ja.summary: 「PlayerUnknown's Battlegrounds」には最新のポリシーが実装されました。今後、ブロックを解除できる回数は、アカウントに 2 番目のパスワードが設定されているかどうかによって異なります。 2次パスワードを設定すると、各アカウントのブロックを半年に1回（年に2回まで）解除できます。同時に、二次パスワードを設定していないプレーヤーは元の標準を維持し、生涯に一度だけアカウントのブロックを解除できます。当局者らは、反チートチームは不正行為と闘う一方、アカウント盗難により不当に追放されたプレイヤーを保護するために関連ポリシーの最適化も行っていると述べた。これにより、セキュリティ対策を積極的に使用するプレイヤーを保護するとともに、まだセカンダリ パスワードを設定していないプレイヤーにそれを有効にすることを奨励します。当局はまた、二次パスワード機能が開始される前にハッキングされ、すでにブロック解除の機会を1回使用したアカウントに対して追加の対策を準備している。プレイヤーがこの状況に陥った場合、カスタマーサービスセンターを通じて再レビュー申請を提出することができます。当局はアカウントが盗まれたかどうかを確認するために再度検査する予定だ。

en.title: Average score of 80: Summary of media ratings for "Sprague Escape Team"
en.summary: "Sprawl: Sprawl Squad" is the first spin-off work in the "Splash" series, and is scheduled to be exclusively launched on the Switch 2 platform on July 23. In this game, the new protagonist "Mechanic" will go on an adventure with the Surah Gang to the "Whirlpool Islands". In addition to single-player play, this game also supports up to four players to play together locally or online. Online play requires a Nintendo Switch Online membership. en.title: [Lottery] Any word can be a curse! The voice magic adventure "Meow Meow" is now officially on sale
en.summary: The voice magic adventure "Meow Meow" is now officially on sale. Can you shoot fireballs by shouting "banana"? Can teammates become bigger just by calling "Big Mac"? Your vocabulary is your arsenal in this voice-enabled magic adventure game that supports up to 4 players online. This work created by an independent team is now officially available on Steam. Players only need to open the spell scroll to bind any word into a spell command, from the serious "Fire Blast" to the outrageous "Barbecue", from "Banana" to "Avada Kedavra". You can say whatever you want and let it go. If you shout right, the spell will take effect immediately; if you shout wrong, your teammates may fall off the cliff, and the scene is bound to be lively. The game contains five floating island worlds with different themes, from Egyptian ruins to ghost castles. The map will be regenerated every time you start, ensuring that every round of exploration is full of freshness. You and your teammates need to jump between platforms to find lost instruments, while avoiding traps and fighting monsters.

ja.title: 【もくじ】どんな言葉も呪いになる！ボイスマジックアドベンチャー『ニャーニャー』正式サービス開始
ja.summary: ボイスマジックアドベンチャー『ニャーニャー』が正式リリースされました。 「バナナ」と叫んで火の玉を飛ばすことができますか？ 「ビッグマック」と呼ぶだけでチームメイトは大きくなれるのか？オンラインで最大 4 人のプレイヤーをサポートするこの音声対応の魔法のアドベンチャー ゲームでは、語彙力が武器となります。独立したチームによって制作された本作が、Steamで正式に提供されるようになりました。プレイヤーは呪文スクロールを開くだけで、深刻な「ファイア ブラスト」からとんでもない「バーベキュー」、「バナナ」から「アバダ ケダブラ」まで、あらゆる単語を呪文コマンドに結び付けることができます。言いたいことは何でも言って、放っておいても大丈夫です。正しく叫べば、呪文はすぐに効果を発揮します。叫び方を間違えると、チームメイトが崖から転落する恐れがあり、現場は必ず盛り上がるはずだ。このゲームには、エジプトの遺跡から幽霊の城まで、異なるテーマを持つ 5 つの浮遊島の世界が含まれています。マップは開始するたびに再生成されるため、探索のどのラウンドも新鮮なものになります。あなたとチームメイトは、罠を避けたりモンスターと戦いながら、プラットフォーム間をジャンプして紛失した楽器を見つける必要があります。

Instead, it uses campus life, after-school chats, summer fireworks displays and winter snow to slowly present a story about friendship, growth and self-awareness. en.title: Off-road motorcycle racing game "MXGP 26" will be released in October
en.summary: The racing simulation "MXGP 26" created by Artefacts Studio has been officially announced and will be released in October. For the first time in the series, this game is developed using Unreal Engine 5 and introduces a real-time terrain deformation system. It is reported that the track surface will produce ruts in real time based on the trajectory of the wheels. This dynamic change will directly affect the physical feedback of the vehicle, and players need to constantly adjust the driving route as the track changes. The developers confirmed that players can play as their favorite riders and compete on all 20 tracks in this game. Players can hone their skills at the comprehensive training ground or refresh their lap times in the time trial. Not only does the quick match support 20 people competing in the same field, but the tournament mode allows players to experience a full season and compete for the championship. The game also comes with an online multiplayer mode that supports global rankings. <For embedded content, please go to the machine core to view it>

en.title: Weird story: Sony’s cancellation of physical discs is frustrating, but it will come sooner or later
en.summary: He is very fond of weird things, and talks about nonsense, ghost things, and new things related to games every day. Maybe I really think so (Photo / Ronaldinho) A few years ago, I went to visit a friend in Beijing. As a native of Beijing and a gamer, he had an entire study room and a large row of bookcases neatly arranged with his massive game collection, from domestic classics from the DOS era to the latest PS game collections. It was really dazzling. In the midst of envy and jealousy, I couldn't help but ache quietly, hoping that everything would be fine for him, who was full of pitfalls. My friends also laughed at me fiercely. After being in the industry for so long, I don’t have as many valuable collections as he does. I thought about it and found that there are actually some collections, such as the "Sword of Immortality" game signed by Yao Zhuangxian. It was really a gift from me when I went to Beijing Softstar for an interview. It is guaranteed to be a fake and is definitely not a signed version of unknown origin. But I really didn’t intend to collect more. I had a feeling very early on that I wanted to rely on my own meager efforts as an ordinary person.

ja.title: 奇妙な話: ソニーの物理ディスクのキャンセルはイライラするが、遅かれ早かれそうなるだろう
ja.summary: 変なものが大好きで、くだらない話や幽霊の話、ゲーム関連の新ネタなどを日々語っています。たぶん本当にそう思っている（写真／ロナウジーニョ） 数年前、私は北京にいる友人を訪ねた。北京出身でゲーマーでもある彼は、書斎全体と本棚の大きな列に、DOS 時代の国内の名作から最新の PS ゲーム コレクションに至るまで、膨大なゲーム コレクションを整然と並べていました。本当にまぶしかったです。羨望と嫉妬の真っ只中、落とし穴だらけの彼にすべてがうまくいくようにと静かに胸を痛めずにはいられませんでした。友達も私を激しく笑いました。この業界に長く携わっていますが、私は彼ほど貴重なコレクションを持っていません。考えてみると、Yao Zhuangxian氏のサイン入りゲーム「Sword of Immortality」など、実際にいくつかのコレクションがあることがわかりました。それは本当に、北京ソフトスターに面接に行ったときに私からプレゼントされたものです。これは偽物であることが保証されており、出所不明の署名付きバージョンではありません。でも本当はこれ以上集めるつもりはなかったのです。私はごく初期の頃から、一般人としての自分の微力な努力に頼りたいと感じていました。

zh.summary: Cloudflare Access 是一项零信任访问控制服务，仅允许特定用户、设备和服务访问应用程序。您只需将 Cloudflare Access 放在互联网上发布的服务前面即可设置，即使服务本身没有登录功能也可以。这次，我们将设置“服务身份验证”，以便我们可以保持浏览器的访问，并允许具有服务令牌的应用程序进行通信。阅读更多...

en.title: I set up the "service authentication" of Cloudflare Access, which can be used for free, and tried accessing the local AI at home from an app on the go.
en.summary: Cloudflare Access is a zero-trust access control service that allows only specific users, devices, and services to access applications. You can set up Cloudflare Access by simply placing it in front of the service published on the Internet, and it is OK even if the service itself does not have a login function. This time, we will set up "service authentication" so that we can maintain access from the browser and also allow communication from apps that have service tokens. read more...

zh.title: Cursor 报告称，在大型 AI 项目中使用“高性能规划器 + 廉价执行器”可将成本降低至约 1/8
zh.summary: 2026年7月20日，开发AI代码编辑器“Cursor”的Anysphere发布了一项实验结果，该实验将大规模开发工作分摊给多个AI代理。即使他们将最高性能的人工智能模型分配给规划者角色，并在实际工作中使用更快、更便宜的模型，他们也能够显着降低成本，同时保持几乎与为所有角色使用高性能模型相同的质量。阅读更多...

en.title: Cursor reports that using ``high-performance planner + inexpensive executor'' in a large-scale AI project reduces the cost to about 1/8th
en.summary: On July 20, 2026, Anysphere, which develops the AI ​​code editor "Cursor," released the results of an experiment in which large-scale development work is divided among multiple AI agents. Even if they assigned the highest-performance AI model to the planner role and used a faster, cheaper model for the actual work, they were able to significantly reduce costs while maintaining almost the same quality as if they used high-performance models for all roles. read more...

ja.summary: Pearl Abyss は本日、同社のオープンワールド アクション アドベンチャー ゲーム Red Desert がクロスプラットフォーム アーカイブをサポートしたことを発表しました。最新のアップデートにより、プレイヤーは共有セーブを使用して PlayStation 5、Xbox Series X|S、Steam、Epic Game Store でシームレスに冒険を続けることができます。クロスプラットフォームのアーカイブにより、プレイヤーはさまざまなプラットフォームのアカウントをリンクし、いつでもどこでもゲームの進行を続けることができます。キャラクターの成長とプロットのステータスは、異なるデバイス間でシームレスに同期できます。プレイヤーはゲーム内の [保存] メニューからこの機能を有効にすることができます。 「クロスプラットフォームアーカイブ設定」を選択後、リンクまたはQRコードを使用して専用のクロスプラットフォームアーカイブページに入ります。画面上の指示に従って、プレーヤーはログインして、PlayStation 5、Xbox Series X|S、Steam、または Epic Games アカウントをリンクできます。

en.title: Pearl Abyss launches cross-platform archive function of "Red Desert", sharing progress across platforms
en.summary: Pearl Abyss announced today that its open-world action-adventure game Red Desert now supports cross-platform archiving. With the latest update, players can use shared saves to seamlessly continue their adventures across PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, Steam and the Epic Game Store. Cross-platform archiving allows players to link accounts on various platforms and continue game progress anytime and anywhere. Character growth and plot status can be seamlessly synchronized between different devices. Players can enable this feature through the in-game Save menu. After selecting "Cross-platform archive settings", use the link or QR code to enter the exclusive cross-platform archive page. Following the on-screen instructions, players can log in and link their PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, Steam or Epic Games accounts.

en.title: Shortwave Roaming Project｜What songs were the world listening to in the 1990s?
en.summary: The title of today's program is called Shortwave Odyssey. In the era before the Internet, if you had a shortwave radio, you could capture the sound from the other side of the world by turning that little knob. We have done a lot of music recommendations on different themes in our previous programs, but it seems that our vision is always limited to a certain region, so I wonder if we would have a different feeling if we listened to music happening in different regions around the world in the same time dimension. So today, we will take this shortwave radio and turn the knob back to 1990. Starting from European and American music, to Chinese, Japanese and Korean regions, to Latin America and the African continent that we rarely pay attention to, listen to the story of world music throughout the year 🎵Songlist Timeline 01:12 Vision of Love - Mariah Carey (USA 1990) 05:55 U Can

ja.title: 短波ローミングプロジェクト｜1990年代に世界中が聴いていた曲とは？
ja.summary: 今日の番組のタイトルは「短波オデッセイ」です。インターネット以前の時代、短波ラジオがあれば、その小さなノブを回すだけで世界の反対側からの音を捉えることができました。これまでの番組でもさまざまなテーマで音楽をレコメンドしてきましたが、どうしても視野が特定の地域に限定されているようなので、世界各地で起きている音楽を同じ時間次元で聴いたらまた違った感じがするのかなと思いました。そこで今日は、この短波ラジオのつまみを 1990 年に戻します。ヨーロッパやアメリカの音楽から始まり、中国、日本、韓国の地域、中南米やアフリカ大陸など、普段はあまり注目することのないワールド ミュージックの物語を、一年を通してお聴きください 🎵ソングリスト タイムライン 01:12 Vision of Love - Mariah Carey (USA 1990) 05:55 U Can

en.title: A case has occurred where a WordPress vulnerability called "wp2shell" is actually being exploited, and the official warns to update to the fixed version as soon as possible.
en.summary: On July 17, 2026, WordPress version 7.0.2 was released, which fixed a vulnerability that allowed remote code execution without authentication. As there are examples of this vulnerability being exploited in the wild, it is recommended that you update your computer immediately. read more...

zh.title: 曾经发生过一个名为“wp2shell”的 WordPress 漏洞实际被利用的案例，官方警告尽快更新至修复版本。

en.title: American Heart Association announces ``optimum daily coffee intake for health''
en.summary: Caffeine, found in coffee and green tea, is one of the most widely consumed psychoactive substances in the world and can also affect a variety of health conditions. The American Heart Association, an American non-profit organization that funds cardiovascular medical research and educates about healthy living, has released a statement on the ``optimum daily coffee intake for health.'' read more...

zh.title: 美国心脏协会宣布“每日最佳健康咖啡摄入量”
zh.summary: 咖啡和绿茶中含有的咖啡因是世界上消费最广泛的精神活性物质之一，也会影响多种健康状况。美国心脏协会是一家资助心血管医学研究并开展健康生活教育的美国非营利组织，该协会发布了一份关于“每日最佳健康咖啡摄入量”的声明。阅读更多...

en.title: OpenAI discloses problems with long-running AI models and suspends internal access to unreleased models that bypassed the sandbox
en.summary: We reported that when OpenAI was operating an unpublished AI model that can work autonomously for long periods of time within the company, we observed behavior that attempted to circumvent the given restrictions and gain external access. The company has temporarily suspended the use of the model and resumed limited internal use with new safety measures in place to monitor all actions. read more...

zh.title: OpenAI 披露了长时间运行的 AI 模型的问题，并暂停了对绕过沙箱的未发布模型的内部访问
zh.summary: 我们报告说，当 OpenAI 运行一个未发布的人工智能模型时，该模型可以在公司内部长时间自主工作，我们观察到试图规避给定限制并获得外部访问权限的行为。该公司已暂时停止使用该模型，并恢复了有限的内部使用，并采取了新的安全措施来监控所有操作。阅读更多...

en.title: Military autonomous vertical takeoff and landing aircraft ``Thunder'' announced, compatible with drone weapons
en.summary: The American defense company ``Anduril'', founded by Palmer Lackey, who is known for developing the VR device ``Oculus Rift'', and the American startup ``Archer Aviation'', which works on electric vertical takeoff and landing aircraft (eVTOL), have jointly announced ``Thunder'', a series hybrid eVTOL platform for both defense and commercial applications. read more...

en.title: Israel spends billions of dollars on influence operations to guide American public opinion, using AI messaging and influencers
en.summary: Israel has continued to carry out attacks on the Palestinian Gaza Strip for a long time, which is also having an impact on negotiations between the United States and Iran to end the hostilities. Amid rising anti-Israel sentiment among Americans, the economic paper Wall Street Journal reported that Israel is spending a large amount of money mobilizing AI and influencers to try to steer American public opinion in Israel's favor. read more...

zh.title: 以色列花费数十亿美元进行影响力行动，利用人工智能消息传递和影响力来引导美国公众舆论

en.title: "Wolong 2: Phoenix Fire to the Sky": a work that stands on the shoulders of "Nioh 3" and its predecessor
en.summary: "Wolong 2: Phoenix Fire to the Sky" | A work that stands on the shoulders of "Nioh 3" and its predecessor is written at the forefront - Machine Check Team NINJA's exclusive interview questions are as follows: 1: From "The Fall of the Sky" to "Phoenix Fire to the Sky", we can't help but think of the classic process from "Yellow Turban Rebellion" to "The Rise of Cao Wei" in KOEI's Three Kingdoms works. This time it continues the previous narrative and tells the "Magic Three Kingdoms" story before Red Cliff. In terms of new stories, what are the highlights that players should pay attention to? The previous work focused on "Wolong", and this work hopes to focus more attention on "Feng Chu". And in the Romance of the Three Kingdoms, Pang Tong finally died in battle at Luofengpo. Although he died young, he was known as the Crouching Dragon and the Phoenix together with Zhuge Liang. The union believes that Bethesda's intensive release of bombshell information on the same day of major layoffs is an attempt to divert attention. en.title: Scientists devise a revolutionary method to remove ``permanent chemicals (PFAS)'' that contaminate agricultural soil
en.summary: Perfluoroalkyl compounds and polyfluoroalkyl compounds (PFAS), which are a type of organic fluorine compounds, are used in frying pan coatings, fire extinguishers, and fast food wrapping paper, but they are also called "eternal chemicals" because they are extremely difficult to decompose. A research team from Yale University in the United States has announced an innovative method to remove PFAS from agricultural soil, which is considered a problem due to its damage to the environment and the human body. read more...

zh.summary: 精灵宝可梦今天（2026年7月27日）宣布，暂时关闭的“精灵宝可梦中心Mega Tokyo”和“皮卡丘Sweets by Pokemon Cafe”将从8月24日起重新营业。

en.title: 6-player cooperative gambling game "Gamble With Your Friends" now supports Japanese with update. A popular work that sold over 2 million copies within one month of release.
en.summary: On July 25, 2026, TENSTACK distributed version 1.0.30 to "GambleWithYourFriends" developed by TEAMGWYF. This makes it compatible with many languages ​​including Japanese. This game is a ``casino crawler'' in which up to six players work together to climb a creepy casino tower and meet quotas set by loan sharks.

zh.title: 6人合作赌博游戏“与你的朋友一起赌博”现已更新支持日语。发行一个月内销量突破200万册的人气作品。
zh.summary: 2026 年 7 月 25 日，TENSTACK 向 TEAMGWYF 开发的“GambleWithYourFriends”分发了 1.0.30 版本。这使得它与包括日语在内的多种语言兼容。这款游戏是一款“赌场爬行者”游戏，最多可有六名玩家合作爬上一座令人毛骨悚然的赌场塔楼，并达到高利贷者设定的配额。

zh.title: “Paranoma Site”系列已在任天堂商店开始销售。 「FILE38 伊势人鱼物语」优惠 30%、「FILE23 本庄七大谜团」优惠 50%

en.title: Sale for the "Paranoma Site" series has started at the Nintendo Store. “FILE38 Ise Mermaid Story” is 30% off, “FILE23 Honjo Seven Mysteries” is 50% off

en.title: He becomes a building manager who works the night shift and responds to calls from tenants who are worried about strange things. Horror simulation “Kaho Hotline Midnight Manager” trailer released
en.summary: BadTapeStudios has released a trailer for a new title currently under development, ``Kaho Hotline Midnight Manager.'' This work is a horror simulation set in the ``Kaho Building,'' an apartment complex full of secrets, where the player plays the role of a night-shift manager who responds to calls from residents. While listening to the calls and checking the instructions, you will find answers to the strange consultations.

zh.title: 他成为一名夜班大楼经理，负责接听担心奇怪事情的租户的电话。恐怖模拟《嘉穗热线午夜经理》预告片发布
zh.summary: BadTapeStudios 发布了目前正在开发的新作《嘉穗热线午夜经理》的预告片。本作是以充满秘密的公寓大楼“嘉穗大厦”为背景的恐怖模拟游戏，玩家扮演一名夜班经理，负责接听居民的电话。在听电话、查看说明的同时，你会找到奇怪咨询的答案。

en.title: Washagana TV's latest video brings you the extra edition (3) of the "Bandai Namco Cross Store Tokyo" business trip edition. Introducing recommended ways to eat Shabuha
en.summary: Today (July 27, 2026), the latest video of the web program "Washagana TV" by Yuichi Nakamura and Mafia Kajita was released. This time, as part (3) of the ``Bandai Namco CrossStore Tokyo'' business trip edition, we will be presenting a dinner party at ``Shabuha'', a specialty restaurant that serves all-you-can-eat shabu-shabu.

zh.title: Washagana TV的最新视频为您带来了“Bandai Namco Cross Store Tokyo”商务旅行版的额外版本（3）。介绍涮火锅的推荐吃法

en.title: New Soullike x Roguelite “Resurgis: Rise of the Dead” demo to be released on Steam in August
en.summary: GoldArrowGames has announced that the demo of its new PC title ``Resurgis: RiseoftheDead'' will be released on Steam in August 2026. This work is a 3D action game that combines Souls-like combat with roguelite elements. A teaser movie will also be posted where you can check out gameplay scenes.

zh.title: 新 Soullike x Roguelite 《Resurgis: Rise of the Dead》试玩版将于 8 月在 Steam 上发布
zh.summary: GoldArrowGames 宣布，其 PC 新作《Resurgis: RiseoftheDead》的试玩版将于 2026 年 8 月在 Steam 上发布。本作是一款结合了魂系战斗与 Roguelite 元素的 3D 动作游戏。还将发布预告片，您可以在其中查看游戏场景。

In this article, we will provide detailed information about the keynote speech on the first day, where the new job "Bastion" and the release date of the Nintendo Switch 2 version were also announced.

en.title: ``An Eggtremely Hard Game'', a two-player cooperative physical action game where you transport eggs in a nest without dropping them, now available on Steam
en.summary: On July 24, 2026, DevotionInteractive released a new title "AnEggstremelyHardGame" developed by BBearStudio. This is a cooperative physical action game in which two players each control a goose to carry a nest containing eggs by holding both ends of it in its mouth.

zh.title: “An Eggtremely Hard Game”，一款两人合作的物理动作游戏，您可以在巢中运输鸡蛋而不掉落它们，现已在 Steam 上发售
zh.summary: 2026年7月24日，DevotionInteractive发布了一款由BBearStudio开发的新游戏《AnEggstremelyHardGame》。这是一款合作的肢体动作游戏，两名玩家分别控制一只鹅，通过用嘴叼住鹅的两端来携带一个装有鸡蛋的巢。

en.title: Announcing the Steam version of the ADV “ZOMBIE Disaster Prevention Training”, which teaches you various ways to deal with a “zombie disaster” that may occur someday.
en.summary: MAGES. today announced the Steam version of ``ZOMBIE Disaster Prevention Training'' currently on sale for Nintendo Switch. This is a point-and-click adventure game in which players learn how to deal with a ``zombie disaster'' that may occur someday using familiar tools.

zh.title: 发布 ADV《僵尸灾难预防训练》的 Steam 版本，教你应对有一天可能发生的“僵尸灾难”的各种方法。

en.title: 5-player cooperative FPS "Codename CURE II", which is free to play, is now available on Steam. Master 5 classes and survive America full of zombies.
en.summary: On July 25, 2026, indie.io began distributing "CodenameCUREII" developed by RaptorByte on Steam. This game is a free-to-play FPS that supports multiplayer for up to 5 players, and the game is set in the United States, which has been infected by a brutal zombie infection.

zh.title: 免费的 5 人合作 FPS 《Codename CURE II》现已在 Steam 上架。掌握 5 个课程并在充满僵尸的美国生存下来。
zh.summary: 2026 年 7 月 25 日，indie.io 开始在 Steam 上分发由 RaptorByte 开发的“CodenameCUREII”。该游戏是一款免费第一人称射击游戏，支持最多 5 名玩家的多人游戏，游戏背景设定在遭受残酷僵尸感染的美国。

en.title: On their first night of marriage, her husband was eaten by a monster. Trial version of ``STARCULT. Night: Twisted Age'', a visual novel that explores the truth of incidents by manipulating one's own ``emotions'', released
en.summary: NOTACATSTUDIOS today (July 27, 2026) released the trial version of their new PC software ``STARCULT.Night:TwistedAge'' on Steam. This work is a dark fantasy visual novel that combines romance and horror elements, where the main character's ``emotions'' fluctuate during conversations and change the flow of the story.

zh.title: 新婚之夜，她的丈夫就被怪物吃掉了。 《STARCULT》试用版。通过操纵自己的“情绪”来探索事件真相的视觉小说《Night：扭曲的时代》发布
zh.summary: NOTACATSTUDIOS 今天（2026 年 7 月 27 日）在 Steam 上发布了他们的新 PC 软件“STARCULT.Night:TwistedAge”的试用版。本作是一部融合浪漫与恐怖元素的黑暗奇幻视觉小说，主角的“情绪”在对话中波动，改变故事的走向。

en.title: Capcom reached about half of its full-year operating profit forecast in the first quarter of the fiscal year ending March 2027. Game sales exceeded 23.81 million units, and ``Pragmata'' exceeded 2.5 million units.
en.summary: Capcom today announced its consolidated financial results for the first quarter of the fiscal year ending March 2027. This term got off to a good start, with significant increases in sales and profits. Operating income reached approximately half of the full-year forecast as of the first quarter. Game sales totaled 23.81 million units, with sales of the new game ``Pragmata'' and repeat titles boosting performance.

zh.title: 截至2027年3月的财年第一季度，卡普空实现了全年营业利润预期的一半左右。游戏销量超过2381万套，《Pragmata》销量超过250万套。
zh.summary: Capcom 今天公布了截至 2027 年 3 月的财年第一季度的综合财务业绩。本财年开局良好，销售额和利润大幅增长。截至第一季度，营业收入达到全年预测的一半左右。游戏销量总计 2,381 万份，其中新游戏《Pragmata》和重复游戏的销量提振了业绩。
