en.title: 'Unacceptable': CTO responds to Xbox service outage
en.summary: Microsoft's Xbox Chief Technology Officer Scott Van Vliet responded to the approximately 16-hour Xbox service outage. On Monday, a large number of players encountered problems logging into Xbox, viewing their game library, and running games. After emergency repairs by the team, the service was officially restored earlier today. Scott Van Vliet admitted that this lengthy outage is completely "unacceptable" and will announce details about improving platform services in the coming weeks. It is reported that the outage originated from an abnormality in an external authorization service last night. Since the operation of Xbox is extremely dependent on this external service, the exception directly caused some login scenarios to fail. Permission verification processes such as loading the complete game library and launching purchased games also failed. Some publishers that rely on the same system have also been affected, causing players to find glitches concentrated only in specific games. X

ja.title: 「容認できない」: Xbox サービス停止に CTO が対応
ja.summary: MicrosoftのXbox最高技術責任者Scott Van Vliet氏は、約16時間にわたるXboxサービス停止について対応した。月曜日、多くのプレーヤーが Xbox へのログイン、ゲーム ライブラリの表示、ゲームの実行で問題に遭遇しました。チームによる緊急修理の後、サービスは本日初めに正式に復旧しました。 Scott Van Vliet氏は、今回の長期停止は完全に「容認できない」ことを認め、今後数週間以内にプラットフォームサービスの改善に関する詳細を発表する予定だ。報告によると、この障害は昨夜の外部認証サービスの異常が原因で発生したとのことです。 Xbox の動作はこの外部サービスに大きく依存しているため、例外が直接の原因となって一部のログイン シナリオが失敗しました。完全なゲーム ライブラリのロードや購入したゲームの起動などの権限検証プロセスも失敗しました。同じシステムに依存している一部のパブリッシャーも影響を受けており、プレイヤーは特定のゲームにのみ不具合が集中していることに気づきました。 ×

en.title: Deep Sea Raft Escape: Multiplayer cooperative survival game "SHORE" officially debuts
en.summary: The latest work "SHORE" from independent game developer "Underdog" was officially announced today. Trapped in the middle of the vast sea, you and your companions ride on a fragile, physically realistic raft to survive together in a desperate situation. Facing storms, tsunamis, sharks and hunger, find your way home in this survival adventure game "SHORE" that supports 1-4 players. "SHORE" is committed to finding a unique gameplay balance between exciting survival gameplay and a relaxed sand sculpture atmosphere. Players need to work together to deal with raging tsunamis and ferocious sharks, and all kinds of outrageous and extreme weather will occur. The game encourages players to be creative in adversity, survive with limited resources, and ultimately find their way back. Previously, the funny game videos released by the developers on social media have accumulated more than 550,000 views, and received more than 2,000 suggestions from users on game features, fully demonstrating players’ understanding of the game’s features.

ja.summary: インディーゲーム開発者「Underdog」の最新作『SHORE』が本日正式発表されました。広大な海の真ん中に閉じ込められたあなたと仲間たちは、壊れやすく物理的に現実的ないかだに乗り、絶望的な状況で一緒に生き延びます。 1 ～ 4 人のプレイヤーをサポートするこのサバイバル アドベンチャー ゲーム「SHORE」で、嵐、津波、サメ、飢えに直面しながら、家に帰る方法を見つけてください。 「SHORE」は、エキサイティングなサバイバル ゲームプレイとリラックスした砂像の雰囲気の間のユニークなゲームプレイ バランスを見つけることに取り組んでいます。プレイヤーは協力して荒れ狂う津波や凶暴なサメに対処する必要があり、あらゆる種類のとんでもない異常気象が発生します。このゲームは、プレイヤーが逆境の中でも創造力を発揮し、限られたリソースで生き残り、最終的には元に戻る方法を見つけることを奨励します。これまで、開発者がソーシャル メディアで公開した面白いゲーム動画は累計 55 万回以上再生され、ゲーム機能についてユーザーから 2,000 件以上の提案を受けており、プレイヤーがゲームの機能を十分に理解していることが十分に証明されています。

en.title: What is "senior anxiety"? Collection here Vol.2
en.summary: Timeline production of this issue: Zhuzhumi Welcome to July's "Gathering Here"! Every month, more than 10,000 updates are generated in the computer core site. The editorial team continuously browses this content in daily operations and selects some posts for sharing and discussion. These posts may be popular or ignored, but they all trigger certain pauses and associations in us. "Gathered Here" is not a selected list with a clear theme, but an attempt to observe and participate in the life shared by the crew. It is hosted by the aircraft core operation team and (planned to) update monthly. This issue covers the crew content from June 20 to July 20. The topics we got from the crew include: What is it like to be a volunteer at nuclear fusion? Anxiety caused by the World Cup public opinion. Do 20-year-olds also have age anxiety? I feel like my concentration and memory have declined, what should I do? The scariest Zhongyuan night talk may come from life. Jiyou’s critical review of "The Back Room"

en.title: Shanghai Spy War Chronicles Issue 1丨Starting from the Storm
en.summary: Timeline production of this issue: Tcho_Tcho This issue of Shanghai Spy War Chronicles will follow the historical context of the awakening of the Chinese working class and the emergence of early revolutionary hidden fronts, and connect a red prequel that is rarely fully told. Shanghai is the cradle of the modern Chinese labor movement. Hundreds of thousands of industrial workers rose up to fight under the triple oppression of imperialism, feudal forces and capital: spontaneous strikes, February protests, Gu Zhenghong’s bloodshed, and the May 30th storm sweeping the country. Amid protests everywhere, workers began to spontaneously form self-defense forces. From Hong Kong seamen and Anyuan miners spontaneously organizing pickets for self-defense, to the general strikes in the provinces and Hong Kong to create formalized workers' armed forces and blockade thousands of miles of sea territory, the first generation of workers' armed forces gradually took shape in the bloody struggle. While the anti-imperialist wave continued to rise, the anti-communist undercurrent of the Kuomintang right wing continued to surge. Liao Zhongkai, the leftist leader who firmly united Russia and the Communist Party and fully supported the workers and peasants movement, was brutally assassinated, and the rift in the cooperation between the Kuomintang and the Communist Party was completely exposed. Zhou Enlai took the lead in establishing Liao Case Special

ja.title: 上海スパイ戦争記 第 1 号丨嵐からの始まり
ja.summary: 今号の年表制作：Tcho_Tcho 今号の上海スパイ戦記は、中国労働者階級の覚醒と初期革命の隠れた前線の出現の歴史的文脈をたどり、ほとんど語られることのない赤い前編を繋ぎます。上海は現代中国労働運動の発祥の地である。帝国主義、封建勢力、資本による三重の抑圧、すなわち自発的ストライキ、2月の抗議行動、顧正紅の流血、そして国を襲った5月30日の嵐という三重の抑圧のもとで、何十万人もの産業労働者が立ち上がって闘った。各地で抗議活動が起きる中、労働者たちは自発的に自衛隊を結成し始めた。香港の船員と安源の鉱山労働者が自衛のために自発的にピケットを組織することから、正式な労働者軍隊を創設し数千マイルにわたる海上領土を封鎖するための地方と香港のゼネストに至るまで、第一世代の労働者武装勢力は血みどろの闘争の中で徐々に形成されていった。反帝国主義の波が高まり続ける一方で、国民党右翼の反共産主義の底流も高まり続けた。ロシアと共産党を固く団結させ、労働者と農民運動を全面的に支援した左翼指導者廖忠凱氏が惨殺され、国民党と共産党の協力関係の亀裂が完全に露呈した。周恩来が率先して「遼事件特集」を設立

en.title: Xbox announces participation details at Gamescom in Germany, live broadcast confirmed simultaneously
en.summary: Microsoft recently announced details of Xbox’s participation in Gamescom in Germany. In addition to offline activities, the official will also conduct special live broadcasts at 22:00 on August 26 and August 27, Beijing time. The program includes exclusive interviews, special guests, live demonstrations and the release of new trailers. Xbox confirmed that the key games on display and available for trial include "Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4", "Fable", "Minecraft: Dungeon 2", "Gears of War: Days of Incident", "Metro 2039", "Heaven" and "Alien: Isolation 2". In order to celebrate the 25th anniversary of the console with players, the Xbox exhibition area will bring a total of 25 unreleased new games and set up 140 trial devices for players to experience. At the same time, an interactive experience area will be set up on site, which will showcase iconic moments, classic works and technological innovations of Xbox consoles of all generations.

ja.title: Xbox、ドイツのGamescomで参加詳細を発表、ライブ放送も同時確認
ja.summary: Microsoft は最近、ドイツでの Gamescom への Xbox の参加の詳細を発表しました。オフライン活動に加えて、関係者は北京時間の8月26日と8月27日の22時に特別生放送も実施する予定だ。このプログラムには、独占インタビュー、特別ゲスト、ライブデモンストレーション、新しい予告編のリリースが含まれます。 Xboxは、展示および試用可能な主要なゲームには、「Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4」、「Fable」、「Minecraft: Dungeon 2」、「Gears of War: Days of Incident」、「Metro 2039」、「Heaven」、「Alien: Isolation 2」が含まれることを確認しました。ゲーム機の 25 周年をプレイヤーと一緒に祝うために、Xbox 展示エリアには合計 25 本の未発売の新作ゲームが展示され、プレイヤーが体験できる試用機が 140 台設置されます。同時に、現場にはインタラクティブな体験エリアが設置され、あらゆる世代のXboxコンソールの象徴的な瞬間、古典的な作品、技術革新が紹介されます。

en.title: Multiplayer co-op game Broke Witcher officially announced
en.summary: The multiplayer cooperative game "Broken Witcher" created by 5TH Cell has been officially announced. In this game, players will join their wizard roommates to kill monsters, race cars, play hide-and-seek with props, or take on other crazy odd jobs, trying to collect the rent before being eaten by the giant little devil landlord. From saving towns to exploring back rooms, from racing magical crows to playing a copycat version of every wizard's favorite Snake: Slitherin' on your phone, the developers say! The world is full of unique and great jobs. Some are well paid. Some are quick and easy. Kill the monsters and save the town, but don't demolish buildings and smash entire neighborhoods in the process, or you won't get paid. Rent isn't due until the weekend, so let's kick back and relax: watch videos, jam to instruments, play tag, have some PvP in the Player Arena, and shoot off some fireworks. Sometimes, fishing is the serious business. try on

en.summary: Code generation using AI is becoming more common, but open source projects are also experiencing situations where maintainers are exhausted by being sent a large number of AI-generated pull requests. The development team of the new open source compiler ``GNU Compiler Collection (GCC)'' has released its acceptance policy for AI-generated code. read more...
